question.text: Fund ABC has an AUM of Rs. 50 crore. What is the MAXIMUM total exposure (long + short after offsetting) the fund can take?

explanation.text: The Logic: Max leverage = 2 × NAV = 2 × 50 crore = Rs. 100 crore total exposure (long + short after permitted offsetting). The Trap: Rs. 50 crore equals 1x (no leverage); Rs. 150 crore is 3x (exceeds cap). Cross-Exam Context: Identical computation applies in CTR leverage reports. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Scheme-level calculation applies — don't average across multiple schemes of the same fund.
